scope: Bounded slice-2 delta only: Krenko goblin-token package, token engine behavior, assignment-2 token repairs, Talrand spell-cast/Drake/flying package, and focused evidence. Does not accept the original eight-list issue #17 gate, #16 integration, arbitrary Commander, UI behavior, or playing strength.

findings.summary: The --commander help still advertises only Isamaru, Jasmine Boreal and Krenko, Mob Boss. Talrand, Sky Summoner is in SUPPORTED_COMMANDERS and is used by the new package, so the user-facing supported-commander list is incomplete.
findings.repro: ./target/release/aperture-cli.exe selfplay --help -> 'Supported commanders: Isamaru, Hound of Konda; Jasmine Boreal; Krenko, Mob Boss'.
findings.expected: Help includes Talrand, Sky Summoner (and remains explicit that these are bounded practice commanders).
findings.impact: Discoverability/help correctness only; Talrand is accepted at runtime.

findings.summary: The engine-only Drake token is named 'Drake Token', while the authoritative token record is named 'Drake' (fixtures/starter-corpus/talrand-sourced.json:29). Event output therefore says 'Drake Token enters the battlefield' instead of the printed token name.
findings.repro: CardId::DrakeToken.def().name is 'Drake Token'; source fixture name is 'Drake'; real Talrand game log contains 'Drake Token enters the battlefield under P3'.
findings.expected: Token display/identity name 'Drake', with type_line 'Token Creature — Drake', 2/2 blue flying. It must remain excluded from catalog::all/by_name and deck import.
findings.impact: Source/implementation identity mismatch for an engine-only token; no import or rules impact found.

findings.summary: The staged roadmap and HANDOFF still describe Talrand spell-cast and Krenko activated token generation as unimplemented, and HANDOFF.md:306 still lists tokens as absent, while this delta implements them as bounded typed packages.
findings.repro: docs/issue17-starter-corpus.md:57-59 lists spell-cast triggers (Talrand) and non-mana activated abilities (Krenko) as roadmap items without marking them partially implemented; HANDOFF.md:306 says 'tokens' are not implemented.
findings.expected: Mark the implemented Talrand spell-cast and Krenko activation as partial/typed package support, and scope remaining token exclusions to types outside the Goblin/Drake package.
findings.impact: Documentation correctness; the manifest and README already describe the partial support correctly.
